label: Post-COVID: a specific neuropsychological profile in performance deficits.
summary: SARS-CoV-2 is frequently associated with cognitive impairment. When symptoms persist for more than four weeks after acute infection, a Long-COVID condition is diagnosed. When persisting more than 12 weeks, Post-COVID ist diagnosed. Cognitive complaints commonly include impairments in attention, memory, and executive functions.
